claims.evidence: Witness photos show a standing stainless/metal gas cooker with 4 burners and an open oven door, but do not confirm 'refurbished' or 'neat' beyond visible surface wear.
Photos show the cooker and oven cavity/racks, but do not show ignition/sparking, oven heating, or any gas-leak safety checks.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite reliably (or ignition system may be faulty), affecting usability
risks.proof: A short video of each of the 4 burners lighting successfully (one-by-one) and staying lit for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/unknown working status (worst case: needs testing/possible burner ignition repair).

risks.risk: Oven burner may not ignite or may heat unevenly / temperature control may be inaccurate
risks.proof: A clip showing oven ignition and a thermometer reading rising and stabilizing (or a test bake result).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as oven performance unverified (worst case: oven not reliable).

risks.risk: Gas safety issues (leaks, worn hoses/regulator, faulty valves) not visible in photos
risks.proof: A gas-leak test demonstration (soap-bubble test) and confirmation of regulator/hoses condition, ideally with a close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with safety risk assumed until tested (worst case: requires gas-safety servicing).

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts (tray/rack, burner caps/spares, knobs) or mismatched burner caps
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/video: all knobs present, burner caps present for all burners, oven racks/tray shown and counted.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/parts may be missing (worst case: missing accessories).

risks.risk: Physical damage not clearly visible (dents, cracks, warped door, damaged hinges) affecting performance and safety
risks.proof: Close-up shots of oven door seal/hinges and the full body for dents/cracks, plus door closing test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetic wear/possible minor damage (worst case: door/hinge issues).

proof_requests: Video: ignite all 4 burners one-by-one and show they stay lit.
Video: ignite the oven burner and show heating (thermometer rise/stabilization).
Demonstrate gas safety: soap-bubble leak test around connections/regulator/valves.
Show all included accessories: oven tray/rack(s), burner caps (and any spares), and confirm all knobs are present.
Close-ups of oven door seal/hinges and any dents/cracks; show the door closes properly.
response.reason: The photos confirm the cooker type (4-burner gas cooker with oven), but they do not verify working condition, ignition, oven heating, or gas-safety—key factors that determine the correct Oyo resale price.
